video_title: Post Game Press Conference l J.B. Bickerstaff l Pistons vs  Celtics   10.20.26 #NBA

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the team's high-level trust in the roster
quotes.excerpt: We got a high-level trust on everybody on our roster.
quotes.quote: We got a high-level trust on everybody on our roster. And we know that at any point in time, you know, we got a guy that we can put in depending on what the mood calls for. Tonight, I thought we needed just a little bit of a boost and Woo, time and time again, does it for us.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff says he has high level trust in the entire Pistons roster and knows he can call on any guy depending on what the game calls for

structured.context: Head coach J.B. Bickerstaff discusses the team's depth and the specific contributions of Wendell Moore Jr. during the post-game press conference.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the team's defensive intensity and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: When we outwork you, we're going to be hard to beat.
quotes.quote: We started defending, and then offensively, we had some guys make some shots, but the movement was there. We were sharing the ball at a high level, finding our guys who were hot. But again, it always starts with our defense. You saw guys diving on the floor, coming up with loose balls. When we outwork you, we're going to be hard to beat.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff emphasizes that the Pistons defensive intensity is the foundation of their success saying when we outwork you we are going to be hard to beat

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff reflects on the team's defensive intensity and ball movement during the game against the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the team's relentless emotional identity
quotes.excerpt: These guys are relentless. They never say die.
quotes.quote: These guys are relentless. They never say die. As long as there's time on the clock, they believe they can win. And it talks to the resolve of the group, but again, how connected the group is. In those moments, you could very easily fracture and everybody could try to go do their own thing, but when we find ourselves in those moments, our guys come together even more, and that's what makes us such a hard out.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff praises the resolve of his group noting that when the game gets tight the team comes together rather than fracturing

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff praises the resilience and emotional connection of his team during high-pressure moments.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on focusing on Pistons basketball over opponent identity
quotes.excerpt: The only thing that matters is if we play Pistons basketball.
quotes.quote: The opponent doesn't matter. What people say doesn't matter. The only thing that matters is if we play Pistons basketball. And I thought tonight we found enough stretches where we did. And when we play Pistons basketball, we're hard to beat, and that's the only thing that matters.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff says the opponent does not matter and the only thing that matters is playing Pistons basketball

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff emphasizes the importance of the team focusing on their own identity rather than the opponent.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the impact of defensive energy and Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: Our defense picked up in that half and we feed off of that.
quotes.quote: Our defense picked up in that half and we feed off of that. And then obviously when Jalen Duren starts making shots, the crowd feeds off of that and we feed off of that. And then again, Woo was doing it on both ends for us. So, when you're in those moments, somebody's got to catch a spark, and I thought Jalen Duren and Woo did a great job of catching that spark for us.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff credits Jalen Duren and Woo for providing the spark the team needed to feed off the crowd energy

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff discusses how the defensive energy and individual performances of Jalen Duren and Wendell Moore Jr. sparked the team.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the team's improved three-point shooting options
quotes.excerpt: You add John, 40 plus percent, Isaiah's 40 plus percent, so obviously you got more options out there.
quotes.quote: You add John, 40 plus percent, Isaiah's 40 plus percent, so obviously you got more options out there that can space it. And guys that have done it at a high clip and when it mattered most. So the shooting is evident and obviously helps.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff notes the impact of adding high level shooters like John and Isaiah saying the shooting is evident and obviously helps

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff comments on the improved floor spacing provided by the team's three-point shooting additions.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the tactical value of Jalen Duren's versatility
quotes.quote: Make us harder to guard. The way that they have to play him is going to be different. Being able to hide Duren a little bit and run some action to bring him back to the ball so they can't just stare him down all the time. But you know again, we want to start to be aggressive. We said that pre-game, we wanted to be assertive, put pressure on people. I was most pleased, he had 11 rebounds. That was important for us to close out possessions because that's what the Celtics do, is come up with offensive boards.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff explains the tactical plan to make the Pistons harder to guard by running action to free up Jalen Duren

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff explains the tactical adjustments made to utilize Jalen Duren's versatility and rebounding against the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on targeting Jayson Tatum defensively
quotes.quote: Ausar Thompson. That's simple. You get him in one-on-one situations, you're going to be in for a long night no matter who you are.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff on defending Jayson Tatum: Ausar Thompson. That is simple. You get him in one on one situations you are going to be in for a long night no matter who you are

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff praises the defensive ability of Ausar Thompson when matched up against Jayson Tatum.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the home-court advantage and crowd energy
quotes.quote: I thought it was awesome. The fact that when we got out there for jump ball, you don't know what to expect just because of the timing of the game. But when we got out there, it was full, it was crowded. And then you felt the energy in the second half. There was no doubt about it. When we got going, they got going and we were feeding off one another, and that's what home-court advantage is. And we got a great home-court advantage.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff praises the Detroit crowd for their energy in the second half calling it a great home court advantage

structured.context: J.B. Bickerstaff discusses the impact of the home crowd energy on the team's performance during the second half.
